value.rationale: Exact phase selection is an algorithmically meaningful structural failure of split flows: original continuous graph equilibrium is never preserved by DRD at any positive step, original physical energy strictly rises at that equilibrium, and RDR has a distinct sharp half-diffusion threshold and opposite large-time phases. This distinguishes modified-energy decay from original-energy behavior, gives a diagnostic for numerical steady states, and holds for arbitrarily large regular bipartite discretizations, not an arbitrary slice or isolated numerical example.
